title: How job fingerprints help us scale down faster
summary: Depot Metal builds runtime estimates from job fingerprints and history. They helped cut p99 host drain time from just over three hours to about one hour.
body_markdown: A job without enough fingerprint data or timing history starts without an estimate. If a job exceeds its estimate, its remaining time becomes unknown instead of zero. Both cases reduce the host's estimate coverage, and the autoscaler falls back to utilization-based selection when no candidate reaches the 80% threshold.
